name: create_appointment
description: MUST call immediately after the caller explicitly confirms one offered slot. Create the appointment using exactly six values: patient_id and caller_full_name from lookup_patient, plus practitioner_id, branch_id, appointment_type_id, and start_time copied unchanged from that exact search_availability slot. Never report a system error unless this tool was actually called and returned ok=false. Never substitute names or placeholders for IDs.

practitioner_id.description: Exact practitioner_id from the confirmed search_availability slot.

branch_id.description: Exact branch_id from the confirmed search_availability slot.

appointment_type_id.description: Exact appointment_type_id from the confirmed search_availability slot.
